# Run and deploy your AI Studio app

This contains everything you need to run your app locally.

View your app in AI Studio: https://ai.studio/apps/c3e13253-b399-4c95-bee0-40355bb1a8a5

## Run Locally

**Prerequisites:**  Node.js


1. Install dependencies:
   `npm install`
3. Run the app:
   `npm run dev`

## Android

The repository now includes an Android WebView wrapper under `android/` and a GitHub Actions workflow under `.github/workflows/android-apk.yml` that builds a test APK automatically.
